summary_en: Miyazaki Bank raised its interim dividend to ¥35 per share from ¥28 and revised its FY2027 year-end dividend forecast to ¥35 per share from ¥28, increasing annual dividend per share to ¥70 from ¥56. The bank targets a payout ratio of approximately 40% by FY2029.
title_en: Notice Regarding Interim Dividend and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
The Miyazaki Bank, Ltd. announced revisions to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, following a board resolution on November 6, 2026. The interim dividend, with a record date of September 30, 2026, was set at ¥35 per share, compared to the prior forecast of ¥28 per share. The year-end dividend was revised upward to ¥35 per share from the previously announced forecast of ¥28 per share. As a result, the annual dividend per share for FY2027 is now projected at ¥70, an increase of ¥14 from the initial forecast of ¥56.

The bank attributed the increase to better-than-expected earnings performance in FY2027. The company has established a policy to actively increase dividends per share with a target payout ratio of approximately 40% by the final year of its medium-term management plan (fiscal year ending March 31, 2029). The interim dividend totaling ¥2,936 million will be paid from retained earnings with an effective date of December 10, 2026. Note that all per-share dividend figures reflect an adjustment for a one-for-five stock split implemented on April 1, 2026.
